title: Anomaly detection scout record
description: One record for each candidate anomaly the scout judged. Subject is `insight:<short_id>:<bucket date>`.

mode.description: `scored` when the candidate came from `$anomaly_score` events, `legacy` when the scout scored the insight itself.

source.description: Where the candidate came from: a `<precheck_result>` row, an `anomaly-search` row, or the legacy watchlist.

verdict.description: `real`: a change in the metric. `artifact`: the detector or the data, not the metric. `expected`: a known launch, migration or seasonal move. `below_bar`: real, but too small to report.

artifact_kind.description: Why the candidate is not a change in the metric. Null when the verdict is not `artifact` or `expected`.

interesting.description: True when a person would want to know, whether or not you filed a report.

report_id.description: The inbox report you authored or edited for this candidate. Null when you filed nothing.

reason.description: One or two sentences on the verdict. No person names, emails or URLs.
